Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the package and the main change: chat({ reasoning }) now maps to --effort for Claude 5 models. The changeset adds seven Claude 5 IDs to CLAUDE_CODE_MODELS and CLAUDE_CODE_REASONING, and haiku-5 is added to EFFORT_MODELS. The title matches the primary fix described in the objectives and linked issue `#2224`.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description covers the required sections. It gives the root cause, the fix, and the test, and it updates the docs and includes a changeset. The checklist is filled in. Two items are left unchecked: the author ran test:lib and test:types instead of pnpm run test:pr, and the no-release box is unchecked. The author explains the test substitution, so the gap is minor.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#2224` asks that the Claude 5 family, including claude-opus-5-5, map chat({ reasoning: { effort } }) to --effort. The issue offers two options; the first is listing the 5-family models with their effort levels. The reviewed diff of packages/ai-claude-code/src/model-meta.ts adds claude-opus-5-5, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-1 to CLAUDE_CODE_MODELS. The same diff maps each of these ids to EFFORT_LOW_TO_MAX in CLAUDE_CODE_REASONING, so resolveReasoning no longer returns undefined for them. The PR summary states that EFFORT_MODELS in adapters/text.ts now matches haiku-5, so Haiku 5.5 receives --effort. I did not inspect text.ts directly. The added test in tests/reasoning-options.test.ts covers the ids and the high to --effort high mapping. I did not run the tests; the test results are author-reported. The coding requirement is met.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changes relate to the Claude 5 reasoning objective. The model-meta.ts changes add the model ids and their reasoning mapping. The text.ts change adds haiku-5 to the effort-model matching, which the objective needs for Haiku 5.5. The test file checks the new ids. The docs change lists the Claude 5 models and their effort levels for the adapter. The changeset records the published patch. The PR leaves off out of scope on purpose, and the description explains why. No unrelated code change is shown in the reviewed evidence.
